$comment: Cotera RevOps Operating System -> Attio custom field spec. Type identifiers are the live values observed on the 'cotera' Attio workspace schema (companies + people) on 2026-08-30.

companies.title: Account Current Thesis
companies.description: Latest account-level hypothesis based on trusted signals and enrichment.

companies.title: Current Thesis Version ID
companies.description: Links CRM context back to Cotera Working Theory / Thesis History.

companies.title: Current Thesis Updated At
companies.description: Last time Cotera refreshed the thesis.

companies.title: Latest Signal Type
companies.description: Latest signal category, e.g. hiring_gtm_engineer, linkedin_pain_post, competitor_post_engagement, community_pain_signal, buyer_intent_post.

companies.title: Latest Signal Summary
companies.description: Plain-English summary of the newest or strongest signal.

companies.title: Latest Signal Source URL
companies.description: Source link for the latest signal.

companies.title: Account Score Reason
companies.description: Why the account received that score.

companies.title: Next Best Action
companies.description: Suggested next action for the rep.

companies.title: Play Key
companies.description: Current play controlling the account/person motion.

companies.title: Cotera Relationship ID
companies.description: Stable relationship ID from Cotera Relationship Mirror.

people.title: Persona Thesis
people.description: Person-specific Current Thesis when different from account-level thesis.

people.title: Persona Angle
people.description: Why this person likely cares based on title, function, persona, and signal.

people.title: 3 Questions to Pressure-Test
people.description: Three concise questions Jim or a rep can use live or in follow-up.

people.title: Call Context
people.description: Compact 500-700 character execution context for calls and Lemlist.

people.title: Context Confidence
people.description: Confidence level in the current context.

people.title: Needs Review
people.description: True when context is useful but not strong enough to treat as authoritative.

people.title: Needs Review Reason
people.description: What is missing, uncertain, or requires human judgment.

people.title: Latest Signal Summary
people.description: Person-level or account-level signal that matters for this person.

people.title: Recommended Play
people.description: Play this person is currently mapped to.

people.title: Cotera Relationship ID
people.description: Stable relationship ID from Cotera Relationship Mirror.
